inventory_audit.description: Reconcile every Wave 5 packet, roadmap, scope, command, and artifact against the frozen scenario inventory before remediation begins.

required.description: Execute a fresh-store production trace proving Work, Claim, Assertion, and SourceSpan identity across Brief, Evidence, Focused Graph, Details, and exact source inspection.
Execute a bounded production query proving citation, support, contradiction, qualification, and inference remain distinct registered relationship meanings.
Execute the existing production Review path for inspect, correction, exact Apply, and governed Revert without a graph-specific command owner.
Execute reload, restart, reconnect, and idempotent replay while proving no duplicate Work result, command, event, ChangeSet effect, or projection effect.
Execute current, working, cached, running, proposed, stale, applied, and projection-catching-up reads without presenting derived or operational state as authority.
Run and retain the source audit proving raw AG-UI event types remain confined to the interaction integration boundary.
Execute client delivery abort and authorized Work cancellation as separate production paths with exact restart-visible outcomes.
Execute UX-FX24 for materially different registered profiles through one bounded renderer-neutral graph and textual-peer contract.
Execute UX-FX25 with dense, cyclic, temporal, stale, partial, restricted, missing, offline, and projection-rebuild states.
Record a critic review of whether relation type, direction, origin, authority layer, and limitations remain identifiable without color or graph position alone.
Record a critic review of whether exact basis, source location, derivation, snapshot, omissions, and projection position can be understood and inspected.
Execute contextual and direct graph entry with exact task, scope, selection, snapshot, origin, and return focus preserved.
Execute Current, Working changes, Historical, comparison, projection freshness, and Return to current without semantic overlap.
Execute the same bounded relationship question through graph and complete textual peer with matching facts, limitations, destinations, and actions.
Execute entry, graph alternative, Details, source inspection, actions, recovery, and return using keyboard with stable visible focus.
Execute citation, support, contradiction, qualification, inference, selection, warnings, and layers with redundant non-color meaning.
Execute named expansion, filtering, caps, hidden/restricted/unknown paths, late response rejection, and selection preservation.
Execute pointer and non-drag correction entry to the existing candidate and Review preview, proving layout coordinates grant no authority.
Execute dedicated comparison, impact, and time views with exact positions, supplied consequences, dates or unknown dates, and textual parity.
Measure and retain dense/cyclic fixture size, query/render timings, layout stability, labels, selection, and environment without inventing a universal threshold.
Execute stale snapshot and out-of-order response behavior with no replacement of newer state and an exact recovery path.
Execute disconnect and offline graph behavior with preserved task, selection, cached-state labeling, retry, and no false currentness.
Execute catching-up, unavailable, rebuilding, and current projection states while PostgreSQL authority and user actions remain accurate.
Execute supported viewports, 200% text, touch/coarse pointer, forced colors, reduced motion, targets, overflow, and browser semantic structure without lost meaning or action.
